events.title: ECOSLO Beach Cleanup at Cayucos Beach
events.summary: Volunteer beach cleanup at Cayucos Beach for statewide Coastal Cleanup Day. Remove litter from this high-use stretch of Central Coast shoreline.

events.title: Cayucos Endless Summer Festival
events.organizer: Friends of Cayucos / Cayucos Chamber of Commerce
events.summary: 3-day community festival with live music, Lions BBQ, Lioness breakfast, Rotary beer & wine tasting, street faire, and coastal history talks.

events.title: Cayucos Antique Street Faire (Fall)
events.venue: Ocean Ave between E St & Cayucos Dr
events.summary: Twice-yearly antique street fair takes over Ocean Ave 7am–3pm. Hundreds of booths with vintage furniture, collectibles, jewelry, and more.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Lions Club
events.summary: Classic cars line downtown Cayucos 8am–4pm. Includes Lions BBQ lunch, live band, and beer garden. Friday check-in party at Nelson's Garage.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos — Holiday Open House & Tree Lighting
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Lioness Club
events.summary: Annual holiday evening with merchant open house, carolers, Santa arriving by fire engine, carriage rides, and community tree lighting on Ocean Ave.
